mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) and nephrotoxicity, while dexamethasone increases electrolyte wasting and immunosuppression, compounding metabolic derangements and infection risk.
action: Monitor electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, potassium, phosphate) frequently, renal function closely, and consider alternative antivirals; ensure adequate electrolyte supplementation if combination is necessary.
